facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident - kinetic exposure at P-3221

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 4 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on P-3221 and M-3221 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. P-3221 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 8 May 2025 a high potential incident was recorded on P-3221 and M-3221 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
